evaluation_dimension_unscored_null.name: evaluation_dimension_unscored_null
evaluation_dimension_unscored_null.value: "evaluation_dimension"."status" not in ('missing_evidence', 'abstained') or ("evaluation_dimension"."score" is null and "evaluation_dimension"."evidence_refs" = '[]')

interview_turn_answer_length.name: interview_turn_answer_length
interview_turn_answer_length.value: "interview_turn"."answer" is null or length("interview_turn"."answer") between 1 and 10000

interview_turn_answer_consistency.name: interview_turn_answer_consistency
interview_turn_answer_consistency.value: ("interview_turn"."status" = 'answered') = ("interview_turn"."answer" is not null and "interview_turn"."answer_submitted_at" is not null)

learning_progress_completion_consistency.name: learning_progress_completion_consistency
learning_progress_completion_consistency.value: ("learning_progress"."status" in ('self_reported', 'verified')) = ("learning_progress"."completed_at" is not null and "learning_progress"."evidence_level" is not null)

learning_progress_evidence_level_match.name: learning_progress_evidence_level_match
learning_progress_evidence_level_match.value: ("learning_progress"."status" = 'self_reported' and "learning_progress"."evidence_level" = 'self_reported') or ("learning_progress"."status" = 'verified' and "learning_progress"."evidence_level" = 'verifiable') or ("learning_progress"."status" in ('started', 'abandoned') and "learning_progress"."evidence_level" is null)

performance_pair_eligible_requires_refer.name: performance_pair_eligible_requires_reference
performance_pair_eligible_requires_refer.value: "performance_pair"."eligibility" <> 'eligible' or ("performance_pair"."reference_score" is not null and "performance_pair"."mae" is not null and "performance_pair"."learning_exposure_matched" and "performance_pair"."retest_interview_id" is not null and abs("performance_pair"."mae" - abs("performance_pair"."predicted_score" - "performance_pair"."reference_score")) < 0.000000001)

transcript_confirmed_consistency.name: transcript_confirmed_consistency
transcript_confirmed_consistency.value: ("transcript"."status" = 'confirmed') = ("transcript"."confirmed_text" is not null and "transcript"."confirmed_at" is not null)
